subject.title: fix(reef): add timeout and bounded JSON reads to relay transport

question: Should every Reef relay REST operation fail after a fixed 15-second pre-header deadline?
rationale: The code correctly prevents indefinite stalls, but repository evidence does not establish Reef's latency contract or prove that healthy supported relays always return headers within 15 seconds.

options.title: Accept the 15-second deadline
options.body: Confirm that the Reef relay contract expects all REST operations to return headers within 15 seconds, then merge the focused patch.

options.title: Adjust the Reef deadline
options.body: Choose a different Reef-owned constant based on the relay's supported latency budget while retaining the shared timeout helper and stalled-server test.

recommendation.title: Accept the 15-second deadline
recommendation.body: Confirm that the Reef relay contract expects all REST operations to return headers within 15 seconds, then merge the focused patch.

likelyOwner.reason: They most recently changed and proved the same Reef transport request boundary on current main.
